gloss: to move up; to be moved forward; to carry (in addition)

definitions.gloss: to move up (in order); to be moved forward (in time)
definitions.explanation: To move to a higher place in a ranking or order, typically because someone ahead drops out, or for a date or time to be brought forward. The intransitive partner of {繰|く}り{上|あ}げる.
In arithmetic, for a digit to carry over to the next column when a column adds up to ten or more. Taught in early elementary school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{順位|じゅんい}→順位：14679_juni⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{繰|く}り{上|あ}がった。
⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一時間|いちじかん}→一時間：00941_ichijikan⟧{繰|く}り{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: The start of the meeting was moved up by an hour.

examples.japanese: {合格者|ごうかくしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{辞退|じたい}→辞退：03338_jitai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{補欠|ほけつ}→補欠：16029_hoketsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{繰|く}り{上|あ}がって⟦{合格|ごうかく}した→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧。
examples.english: Because some successful applicants declined, he moved up from the waiting list and was accepted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{八|はち}→八：00698_hachi⟧⟦{足|た}す→足す：01168_tasu⟧⟦{五|ご}→五：00697_go⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{繰|く}り{上|あ}がって⟦{十三|じゅうさん}→十三：00954_juusan⟧だ。
examples.english: Eight plus five carries over and makes thirteen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一年生|いちねんせい}→一年生：27559_ichinensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{算数|さんすう}→算数：04170_sansuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{繰|く}り{上|あ}がり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{足|た}し{算|ざん}→足し算：05332_tashizan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦つまずく→つまずく：06970_tsumazuku⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In first-grade arithmetic, many children stumble on addition with carrying.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Intransitive: 〜⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{繰|く}り{上|あ}がる; transitive partner ⟦{繰|く}り{上|あ}げる→繰り上げる：07007_kuriageru⟧ (to move something up)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {繰|く}り{上|あ}がり⟦{当選|とうせん}→当選：07074_tousen⟧: winning a seat by moving up after someone else withdraws
- {繰|く}り{上|あ}がり⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧: acceptance from the waiting list
- {繰|く}り{上|あ}がり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{足|た}し{算|ざん}→足し算：05332_tashizan⟧: addition with carrying

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {繰|く}り{下|さ}がる: to move down; to borrow (in subtraction) — the opposite in both senses
